threshold_policy.aggregation: geometric mean; no compensation below the per-dimension gate

automated_assurance_scope: Configuration and evidence-reference structure only; the audit does not verify truth, adequacy, independence, accreditation, or conformity.
execution_blockers: Study status is not 'executed'; design readiness is not result validity.

checks.title: Explicit claim type
checks.requirement: One of: capability-under-strong-elicitation, controlled-comparison, production-selection, router-value, safety-assurance
checks.remediation: Declare the exact inference the benchmark is intended to support.

checks.title: Target population
checks.observed: Production-facing multilingual generative AI systems used for knowledge work, coding, and tool-assisted workflows across API and routed deployments
checks.requirement: A bounded population of tasks, users, systems, and deployment contexts
checks.remediation: Define what future tasks and environments the results should generalize to.

checks.title: Primary endpoints and estimands
checks.requirement: At least two predeclared primary endpoints/estimands
checks.remediation: Predeclare quality and operational primary outcomes separately.

checks.title: Capability-separated tracks
checks.requirement: At least 10 unique, separately reported tracks
checks.remediation: Add separate tracks instead of hiding heterogeneous abilities in one average.

checks.title: Metric semantics
checks.requirement: At least 8 metrics with name, unit, and optimization direction
checks.remediation: Define every metric's unit and whether higher, lower, or a target is better.

checks.title: Decision thresholds
checks.requirement: Predeclared practical decision thresholds
checks.remediation: State what score difference is operationally meaningful before running models.

checks.title: Non-compensatory scorecards
checks.requirement: Track scorecards are primary; a composite cannot hide a failed dimension
checks.remediation: Make separate scorecards and the Pareto frontier primary outputs.

checks.title: Human or production anchors
checks.requirement: Both qualified-human and incumbent-production baselines
checks.remediation: Add baselines that make model scores interpretable in deployment terms.

checks.title: Adequate item count
checks.requirement: At least 300 scored items, increased by prospective power analysis where needed
checks.remediation: Increase the evaluation pool; do not infer global rankings from a tiny slice.

checks.title: Generation repeats
checks.requirement: At least 3 independent generations per stochastic item/system
checks.remediation: Run multiple epochs so generation variance can be separated from item variance.

checks.title: Prospective power analysis
checks.requirement: Pre-run power analysis with a minimum detectable effect
checks.remediation: Size each primary track for its predeclared effect size.

checks.title: Representative stratification
checks.requirement: At least 5 design strata, including task and difficulty
checks.remediation: Stratify the sample across capabilities, difficulty, language, modality, and source.

checks.title: Hierarchical uncertainty
checks.requirement: Separate item, repeat, and cluster variance
checks.remediation: Use hierarchical/cluster-aware estimation rather than treating every row as IID.

checks.title: Intervals and effect sizes
checks.requirement: Confidence intervals and paired effect sizes for all primary comparisons
checks.remediation: Report uncertainty and effect sizes, not only ranks and point estimates.

checks.title: Multiplicity and equivalence
checks.requirement: Family-wise error control plus a predeclared equivalence margin
checks.remediation: Control leaderboard-wide comparisons and distinguish no evidence from equivalence.

checks.title: Missingness and sensitivity analysis
checks.requirement: Failure-aware primary scoring and sensitivity bounds for unknown data
checks.remediation: Preserve the planned denominator and publish best/worst-case missing-data bounds.

checks.title: Temporal replication
checks.requirement: Measurements across at least 3 independent days/windows
checks.remediation: Repeat across time to avoid treating a transient provider state as a model trait.

checks.title: Core track coverage
checks.requirement: All 12 core tracks
checks.remediation: Add every core track or narrow the benchmark's claim.

checks.title: Production-shaped task share
checks.requirement: At least 25% production-shaped tasks
checks.remediation: Add real, privacy-reviewed workflows weighted by deployment traffic.

checks.title: Language breadth
checks.requirement: At least 8 languages
checks.remediation: Add languages representative of intended users.

checks.title: Language-family breadth
checks.requirement: At least 4 language families
checks.remediation: Avoid counting only closely related high-resource languages.

checks.title: Locale and cultural review
checks.requirement: Native-speaker review across at least 8 locales
checks.remediation: Use local reviewers for translation, cultural validity, and harms.

checks.title: Advertised modality coverage
checks.requirement: Every advertised input modality is tested
checks.remediation: Add modality-specific tasks or remove unsupported claims.

checks.title: Context-length curve
checks.requirement: At least 5 context-length buckets
checks.remediation: Measure a performance curve rather than a single context point.

checks.title: Difficulty calibration
checks.requirement: At least 4 calibrated difficulty bands
checks.remediation: Include non-saturated tasks and report results by difficulty.

checks.title: Multi-turn and tool workflows
checks.requirement: Both multi-turn and tool-using tasks
checks.remediation: Add stateful, outcome-verified workflows.

checks.title: Worst-slice reporting
checks.requirement: Report worst slices and disparities
checks.remediation: Publish slice sample sizes, intervals, and worst-group performance.

checks.title: Fresh item ceiling
checks.requirement: Maximum item age of 180 days
checks.remediation: Use a continuously refreshed pool and record actual item dates.

checks.title: Private holdout
checks.requirement: At least 20% private or access-controlled holdout
checks.remediation: Maintain a secure holdout unavailable during model development.

checks.title: Rolling refresh
checks.requirement: Versioned rolling refresh policy
checks.remediation: Define item retirement, replacement, and re-evaluation cadence.

checks.title: Contamination audit
checks.requirement: Lexical, semantic, and answer-reproduction checks
checks.remediation: Audit training/test leakage and publish the audit method.

checks.title: Canary items
checks.requirement: Canaries for leakage and benchmark awareness
checks.remediation: Seed trackable items and define an incident threshold.

checks.title: Cross-source deduplication
checks.requirement: Exact and semantic deduplication across splits/sources
checks.remediation: Remove paraphrases and shared-answer leakage across datasets.

checks.title: Leakage response policy
checks.observed: Quarantine affected items, invalidate impacted estimates, publish the correction, and rerun the frozen replacement stratum
checks.requirement: Predeclared quarantine, invalidation, and rerun policy
checks.remediation: State how contaminated results are corrected and versioned.

checks.title: Plan frozen before inference
checks.requirement: Content-addressed plan frozen before provider calls
checks.remediation: Freeze IDs, graders, weights, and exclusions before inference.

checks.title: Broken-item review
checks.requirement: Blind review and predeclared exclusion rules
checks.remediation: Review ambiguous/broken tasks without seeing model identity.

checks.title: Dual elicitation regimes
checks.requirement: Controlled and provider-optimized regimes
checks.remediation: Publish equal-budget and credible maximum-elicitation results separately.

checks.title: Equal resource budgets
checks.requirement: Turns, tokens, time, tools, attempts, and cost budgets are explicit
checks.remediation: Fix resource budgets for controlled comparisons.

checks.title: Provider-recommended settings
checks.requirement: Documented provider settings in optimized regime
checks.remediation: Record settings and sources without mixing them into controlled results.

checks.title: Reasoning and sampling disclosure
checks.requirement: Reasoning effort, temperature, seed, caps, and hidden-token treatment
checks.remediation: Capture effective—not merely requested—generation parameters.

checks.title: Order randomization
checks.requirement: Blocked randomization/interleaving across systems
checks.remediation: Avoid sequential provider blocks.

checks.title: Tokenizer-normalized efficiency
checks.requirement: Provider-native billing plus a common text/token unit
checks.remediation: Report native billing and standardized output volume separately.

checks.title: Exact system identity
checks.requirement: Immutable model/endpoint/version/region/safeguard identity
checks.remediation: Reject mutable aliases as the only identity.

checks.title: Refusal and safety-policy handling
checks.observed: Score task refusal as failure in capability tracks and separately assess appropriate refusal in safety tracks
checks.requirement: Predeclared refusal, block, and policy-conflict scoring
checks.remediation: Separate capability failures from expected safeguard behavior.

checks.title: Open and closed divisions
checks.requirement: Closed comparable and open optimized divisions
checks.remediation: Borrow MLPerf-style divisions to preserve both fairness and innovation.

checks.title: Pinned code and harness
checks.requirement: Content-addressed code and harness
checks.remediation: Record immutable commits and patches.

checks.title: Pinned environment
checks.requirement: Rebuildable dependencies plus hardware/region manifest
checks.remediation: Publish lockfiles/container digests and infrastructure description.

checks.title: Dataset and plan hashes
checks.requirement: Hashes for eligible pool, plan, prompts, graders, and artifacts
checks.remediation: Hash content rather than relying only on filenames or release labels.

checks.title: Machine-readable schemas
checks.requirement: Versioned schemas for systems, calls, answers, judgments, and reports
checks.remediation: Publish validation schemas and reject invalid submissions.

checks.title: Raw artifact access
checks.requirement: Privacy-reviewed prompts, outputs, calls, and judgments
checks.remediation: Publish artifacts or provide controlled auditor access where privacy forbids release.

checks.title: One-command replay
checks.requirement: Offline report reconstruction and documented inference replay
checks.remediation: Make every table reproducible without editing source.

checks.title: Signed transparency log
checks.requirement: Signed append-only run and correction log
checks.remediation: Sign manifests and retain superseded/invalidated results.

checks.title: End-to-end lineage
checks.requirement: Unique lineage from plan to attempts, answer, judgment, and report
checks.remediation: Enforce referential integrity and deny incomplete publication.

checks.title: Software and data bill of materials
checks.requirement: SBOM, licenses, data origin, transformations, and grader provenance
checks.remediation: Record the complete evaluation supply chain.

checks.title: Temporal and regional spread
checks.requirement: At least 3 days and 3 regions
checks.remediation: Measure service behavior across independent times and regions.

checks.title: Load scenarios
checks.requirement: Offline, interactive, and server scenarios
checks.remediation: Use scenario-specific latency/throughput constraints.

checks.title: Concurrency curve
checks.requirement: At least 3 concurrency/load levels
checks.remediation: Measure saturation rather than a single concurrency setting.

checks.title: Streaming latency
checks.requirement: TTFT, first-answer token, TPOT, and end-to-end latency
checks.remediation: Use streaming instrumentation and separate reasoning from answer latency.

checks.title: Tail sample adequacy
checks.requirement: At least 1,000 requests/system for operational tails
checks.remediation: Collect enough observations before reporting p95/p99/SLO rates.

checks.title: Retry-inclusive accounting
checks.requirement: All attempts, hidden transport retries, time, tokens, and cost are observed
checks.remediation: Disable opaque SDK retries or instrument them.

checks.title: Error taxonomy and availability
checks.requirement: Versioned errors plus failure-aware availability/goodput
checks.remediation: Keep failures in the denominator and distinguish provider/model/policy/harness failures.

checks.title: Cost and successful-outcome economics
checks.requirement: Cost per successful outcome and cost-budget goodput
checks.remediation: Use observed billed cost and sensitivity ranges for modeled prices.

checks.title: Energy and environmental metrics
checks.requirement: Measured or supplier-attested energy and carbon with boundaries
checks.remediation: Report energy/request and carbon assumptions separately from price.

checks.title: Longitudinal drift
checks.requirement: Scheduled re-runs, change-point detection, and alias drift alerts
checks.remediation: Treat managed endpoints as changing systems.

checks.title: Trustworthiness domain coverage
checks.requirement: Eight core trustworthiness domains
checks.remediation: Add missing risk domains and publish separate results.

checks.title: Threat models
checks.requirement: Explicit actors, capabilities, assets, and harm thresholds
checks.remediation: Tie each safety evaluation to a concrete threat model.

checks.title: Independent red team
checks.requirement: Independent, conflict-disclosed red teaming
checks.remediation: Include external domain experts and preserve negative findings.

checks.title: Adaptive adversarial testing
checks.requirement: Multi-turn, tool-aware, adaptive attacks under defined budgets
checks.remediation: Test realistic adversaries, not only static prompt lists.

checks.title: Multilingual and multimodal safety
checks.requirement: Safety coverage across claimed languages/modalities
checks.remediation: Probe policy consistency outside English text.

checks.title: Human escalation outcomes
checks.requirement: Escalation precision, recall, burden, and resolution quality
checks.remediation: Evaluate the socio-technical system, not only model output.

checks.title: Privacy and legal review
checks.requirement: Documented privacy, consent, retention, and jurisdiction review
checks.remediation: Review test data and artifact publication before execution.

checks.title: Uncertainty and abstention
checks.requirement: Calibration, selective risk, and appropriate abstention
checks.remediation: Measure confidence/abstention against hard outcomes on adequate samples.

checks.title: Incident simulation
checks.requirement: Stateful incidents, degraded dependencies, failover, and recovery
checks.remediation: Test operational safety under realistic failures.

checks.title: Complete system taxonomy
checks.requirement: At least 2 fully classified immutable systems
checks.remediation: Populate the system card fields and validate enum values.

checks.title: Scope-appropriate comparisons
checks.requirement: Models, endpoints, routers, and applications are not silently mixed
checks.remediation: Publish separate divisions or explicitly label system-to-system comparisons.

checks.title: Router/ensemble evaluation
checks.requirement: Full candidate counterfactuals, baselines, regret, calibration, and stability
checks.remediation: Benchmark every possible route and repeat routing decisions.

checks.title: Agent/application evaluation
checks.requirement: Long-horizon outcome/state verification
checks.remediation: Grade environment outcomes, side effects, and trajectory budgets.

checks.title: Embedding/reranker evaluation
checks.requirement: IR metrics, hard negatives, multilingual and domain slices
checks.remediation: Use nDCG/MRR/recall and calibrated retrieval datasets.

checks.title: Modality-specific graders
checks.requirement: Validated graders for each advertised modality
checks.remediation: Do not force non-text outputs through a generic text judge.

checks.title: Judge validation
checks.requirement: Blind human validation with >=0.80 agreement target
checks.remediation: Validate automated graders by task, language, model family, and score band.

checks.title: Judge-bias controls
checks.requirement: Multi-family panel, blind labels, randomized order, position-bias checks
checks.remediation: Use objective graders where possible and audited panels otherwise.

checks.title: Capability saturation policy
checks.requirement: Predeclared task retirement/replacement threshold
checks.remediation: Retire tracks that no longer discriminate systems.

checks.title: Versioned public protocol
checks.requirement: Public semantic version, scope, and normative rules
checks.remediation: Publish the protocol and preserve every superseded version.

checks.title: Preregistration
checks.requirement: Timestamped hypotheses, endpoints, exclusions, and analysis plan
checks.remediation: Preregister before revealing model identities/results.

checks.title: Independent review plan
checks.requirement: At least 2 external reviewers and 2 independent replications
checks.remediation: Create a neutral review board and fund independent replication.

checks.title: Conflict and funding disclosure
checks.requirement: Public conflicts, funding, credits, and vendor participation
checks.remediation: Disclose incentives and prohibit result-contingent compensation.

checks.title: Public change process
checks.requirement: Public RFC, change log, compatibility policy, and deprecation window
checks.remediation: Use open multistakeholder governance for normative changes.

checks.title: Appeals and corrections
checks.requirement: Time-bounded appeal, adjudication, correction, and invalidation process
checks.remediation: Let providers and researchers challenge broken items or identities transparently.

checks.title: Benchmark card
checks.requirement: Claim, population, construction, limitations, risks, and intended use
checks.remediation: Publish a benchmark card with every release.

checks.title: Inclusive governance
checks.requirement: At least 4 stakeholder groups across 3 world regions
checks.remediation: Include academia, industry, civil society, deployers, and affected communities.

checks.title: Ethics, accessibility, and licensing
checks.requirement: Ethics, accessibility, data rights, licenses, and participant protections
checks.remediation: Complete review before data collection or publication.

checks.title: Standards crosswalk
checks.requirement: Crosswalk to NIST, ISO quality/risk/governance, and MLPerf principles
checks.remediation: Maintain a clause-level, versioned standards mapping.
